message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend public holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend).  
I’ve grouped them by the federal holiday that creates the long weekend and noted the province(s) where the holiday is observed (some holidays are province‑specific).  

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **March 20, 2023** | Family Day | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba | Fri – Mon |
| **April 7, 2023** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | Fri – Mon |
| **May 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | Fri – Mon |
| **September 4, 2023** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | Fri – Mon |
| **October 9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | Fri – Mon |
| **December 25, 2023** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | Fri – Mon |

### Notes & Quick Tips

| Holiday | Extra Details |
|---------|---------------|
| **Family Day** | Observed on the 3rd Monday in February in British Columbia, Yukon, and the Northwest Territories; on the 3rd Monday in February in Nova Scotia and New Brunswick; on the 3rd Monday in February in Prince Edward Island; on the 3rd Monday in February in Newfoundland & Labrador (St. Patrick’s Day); on the 3rd Monday in February in Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba. In 2023, the 3rd Monday in February was **Feb 20**, but the 3rd Monday in March (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) was **Mar 20**. |
| **Good Friday** | Federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Victoria Day** | Federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Labour Day** | Federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Christmas Day** | Federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |

> **Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can pull the full list of Canadian public holidays (including province‑specific ones) from the Nager.Date API:  
> `https://date.nager.at/api/v2/PublicHolidays/2023/CA`  
> This endpoint returns a JSON array of all holidays for Canada in 2023, which you can filter for those that fall on a Friday or Monday to automatically generate long‑weekend spans.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown (e.g., province‑by‑province lists, or including holidays that create “extended” weekends when people take an extra day off). Happy planning!
